headline: The bot team is registered and the shared repos are live; first assignments are next.
items: The shared knowledge base repo is set up with folders for research, decisions, tasks, leads and meetings.
25 bots are registered: 11 active and 14 planned.
Team rules for naming, registering and status updates are in place.
All 11 active bots report idle and are waiting for their first assignment.
The Virtual Office status board has a new swimlane layout.
Nothing has been filed yet: no research, decisions or meeting notes so far.
